title: 預鑄混凝土耐震接頭
summary: 從預鑄構架的地震傳力路徑與自復位原理出發，計算混合預力梁柱接頭的開口、鋼腱應力與軟鋼脫黏長度，設計灌漿套筒續接，再處理吊裝期間的臨時穩定、樓梯與樓板的支承長度與滑動縫、ACI 374.1 試驗允收與 PRESSS 縮尺試驗，最後談套筒灌漿缺陷檢測與震後預力復驗，並以 The Paramount、PRESSS 試驗建築與基督城地震的公開教訓對照。
summaryEn: Starting from the seismic load path of precast frames and the principle of self-centring, compute gap opening, tendon stress and mild-steel debonded length in hybrid post-tensioned beam–column joints and design grouted sleeve splices, then handle temporary stability during erection, seating length and sliding joints for stairs and floors, ACI 374.1 test acceptance and the PRESSS scaled test, and finally detection of sleeve grouting defects and post-earthquake prestress checks, compared with public lessons from The Paramount, the PRESSS test building and the Christchurch earthquake.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitleEn: Building seismic, precast and fire safety

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：某預鑄混合抗彎構架梁深 700 mm，梁端以無黏結鋼腱施加 P = 1,200 kN（初始 0.55 f_pu ≈ 1,023 MPa），力臂 0.35 m，M_pt = 420 kN·m；上下緣軟鋼 A_s = 1,000 mm²，以 1.25 f_y = 525 MPa、力臂 0.55 m 計，M_s ≈ 289 kN·m，復位比 λ ≈ 1.45。設計層間變位 2% 時梁端開口 14 mm，16 m 長鋼腱應力增約 171 MPa 至約 1,194 MPa；軟鋼伸長 12 mm，以 3% 應變上限需脫黏 400 mm。柱底 D32 灌漿套筒以 τ = 12 MPa 計需埋入約 413 mm，提供 512 mm。若最大考量地震變位達 3.5%，開口增為約 24.5 mm，鋼腱應力約 1,322 MPa 仍低於降伏，但軟鋼伸長 21 mm，脫黏長度須增至約 700 mm；若震後浮升試驗發現預力損失 15%，λ 降為約 1.23。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a precast hybrid moment frame has 700 mm beams post-tensioned with unbonded tendons at P = 1,200 kN (initially 0.55 f_pu ≈ 1,023 MPa) at a 0.35 m lever arm, so M_pt = 420 kN·m; top and bottom mild steel A_s = 1,000 mm² at 1.25 f_y = 525 MPa and a 0.55 m lever arm gives M_s ≈ 289 kN·m and a recentring ratio λ ≈ 1.45. At 2% design drift the beam-end gap is 14 mm and a 16 m tendon gains about 171 MPa to about 1,194 MPa; the mild steel elongates 12 mm, needing 400 mm of debonding for a 3% strain limit. D32 grouted sleeves at the column base need about 413 mm of embedment at τ = 12 MPa, and 512 mm is provided. If the maximum considered drift reaches 3.5%, the gap grows to about 24.5 mm and tendon stress to about 1,322 MPa, still below yield, but the mild steel elongates 21 mm and needs about 700 mm of debonding; if a post-earthquake lift-off test finds 15% prestress loss, λ drops to about 1.23. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「預鑄構架的地震傳力路徑」與「接合式系統的自復位與旗形遲滯」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Seismic load path in precast structures" and "Self-centring and flag-shaped hysteresis in jointed systems": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 預鑄構架的地震傳力路徑：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Seismic load path in precast structures: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「樓板隔板接合器」如何影響預鑄混凝土耐震接頭的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Diaphragm connectors” governs force, deformation or durability in “Seismic connections for precast concrete”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 現澆混凝土建築的連續性是自然形成的，預鑄建築則必須由接頭刻意建立：樓板慣性力經板間接合器、弦材與集力構件傳到抗側力牆或構架，再經柱底或牆底接頭進入基礎。任何一段接頭不足，整條路徑就斷開。設計上有兩種策略：等同現澆（emulative）讓接頭比構件更強，把塑性鉸推離接頭；接合式（jointed）則讓變形集中在接頭本身，以預力與耗能元件控制行為。1994 年 Northridge 地震中預鑄停車結構的倒塌，正是傳力路徑在接頭處中斷的典型。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「樓板隔板接合器」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Continuity in cast-in-place concrete arises naturally, whereas in precast buildings it must be created deliberately by connections: floor inertia forces travel through panel-to-panel connectors, chords and collectors to lateral walls or frames, then through column-base or wall-base joints into the foundation. If any connection is inadequate, the path is broken. Design follows one of two strategies: emulative, making connections stronger than members so plastic hinges move away from the joints, or jointed, concentrating deformation in the joints themselves and controlling it with prestress and dissipating elements. Collapses of precast parking structures in the 1994 Northridge earthquake typify a load path broken at the connections. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Diaphragm connectors” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：某樓層重量 W = 8,000 kN、隔板設計加速度 0.3 g，樓板慣性力 F = 0.3×8,000 = 2,400 kN，由兩道剪力牆各承受 1,200 kN；每道牆沿線設 12 個板—牆接合器，平均每個 100 kN，若隔板依規範要求以 2.0 倍超強設計，每個接合器需約 200 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A floor weighing W = 8,000 kN with a diaphragm design acceleration of 0.3 g develops an inertia force F = 0.3×8,000 = 2,400 kN, shared by two shear walls at 1,200 kN each; with 12 slab-to-wall connectors along each wall, the average is 100 kN per connector, and with a diaphragm overstrength of 2.0 each needs about 200 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「預鑄構件本身強度足夠，接頭只要能承受重力就好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If precast members are strong enough, connections only need to carry gravity loads." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「樓板隔板接合器」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Diaphragm connectors”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 預鑄構架的地震傳力路徑：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Seismic load path in precast structures: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「樓板隔板接合器」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Diaphragm connectors” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：某樓層重量 W = 8,000 kN、隔板設計加速度 0.3 g，樓板慣性力 F = 0.3×8,000 = 2,400 kN，由兩道剪力牆各承受 1,200 kN；每道牆沿線設 12 個板—牆接合器，平均每個 100 kN，若隔板依規範要求以 2.0 倍超強設計，每個接合器需約 200 kN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A floor weighing W = 8,000 kN with a diaphragm design acceleration of 0.3 g develops an inertia force F = 0.3×8,000 = 2,400 kN, shared by two shear walls at 1,200 kN each; with 12 slab-to-wall connectors along each wall, the average is 100 kN per connector, and with a diaphragm overstrength of 2.0 each needs about 200 kN. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：繪製每一樓層的傳力路徑圖，標示每個接合器、弦材與集力構件的需求與容量，確認從樓板到基礎沒有任何一段僅靠摩擦或未設計的接觸傳力；審查時逐一核對接頭型式與設計策略（等同現澆或接合式）是否一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Draw a load-path diagram for every floor showing demand and capacity of each connector, chord and collector, confirming that no link from slab to foundation relies on friction or undesigned contact; at review, check that each connection type matches its design strategy, emulative or jointed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 預鑄構架的地震傳力路徑：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Seismic load path in precast structures: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「樓板隔板接合器」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Diaphragm connectors” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 繪製每一樓層的傳力路徑圖，標示每個接合器、弦材與集力構件的需求與容量，確認從樓板到基礎沒有任何一段僅靠摩擦或未設計的接觸傳力；審查時逐一核對接頭型式與設計策略（等同現澆或接合式）是否一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw a load-path diagram for every floor showing demand and capacity of each connector, chord and collector, confirming that no link from slab to foundation relies on friction or undesigned contact; at review, check that each connection type matches its design strategy, emulative or jointed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計說明應明列整棟建築採用的耐震策略與每種接頭的類別，並要求預鑄廠的接頭細部圖由結構技師核可；未經核可不得以其他接頭替代。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The design basis should state the seismic strategy for the building and the category of every connection type, with the precaster's connection details approved by the structural engineer; no substitution without approval.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：隔板接合器或集力構件不足時，地震中樓板與牆分離，樓板失去側向支撐，柱承受未設計的大變形而破壞；若只依重力荷載設計擱置支承，板件在大變位下從支承滑落。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: With inadequate diaphragm connectors or collectors, floors separate from walls in an earthquake, columns lose lateral support and fail under undesigned deformation; bearings designed for gravity alone let units slide off at large displacement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 繪製每一樓層的傳力路徑圖，標示每個接合器、弦材與集力構件的需求與容量，確認從樓板到基礎沒有任何一段僅靠摩擦或未設計的接觸傳力；審查時逐一核對接頭型式與設計策略（等同現澆或接合式）是否一致。
knowledge.textEn: Draw a load-path diagram for every floor showing demand and capacity of each connector, chord and collector, confirming that no link from slab to foundation relies on friction or undesigned contact; at review, check that each connection type matches its design strategy, emulative or jointed.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計說明應明列整棟建築採用的耐震策略與每種接頭的類別，並要求預鑄廠的接頭細部圖由結構技師核可；未經核可不得以其他接頭替代。
knowledge.textEn: The design basis should state the seismic strategy for the building and the category of every connection type, with the precaster's connection details approved by the structural engineer; no substitution without approval.

quiz.question: 要驗證「預鑄構架的地震傳力路徑」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Seismic load path in precast structures"?
options: 繪製每一樓層的傳力路徑圖，標示每個接合器、弦材與集力構件的需求與容量，確認從樓板到基礎沒有任何一段僅靠摩擦或未設計的接觸傳力。

steps.instruction: 隔板接合器或集力構件不足時，地震中樓板與牆分離，樓板失去側向支撐，柱承受未設計的大變形而破壞；若只依重力荷載設計擱置支承，板件在大變位下從支承滑落。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.title: 接合式系統的自復位與旗形遲滯：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Self-centring and flag-shaped hysteresis in jointed systems: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「旗形遲滯迴圈」如何影響預鑄混凝土耐震接頭的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Flag-shaped hysteresis” governs force, deformation or durability in “Seismic connections for precast concrete”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 接合式預鑄構架把梁與柱以無黏結預力鋼腱夾在一起，地震時梁端與柱面之間張開一個縫，構件本身幾乎不受損；預力在震後把縫重新壓合，使結構回到原位，這就是自復位。只有預力時遲滯迴圈幾乎沒有面積，耗能不足，因此再加入會降伏的軟鋼筋或耗能元件，得到形如旗子的遲滯迴圈：既能耗能，又能在卸載後歸零。關鍵在於預力提供的回復彎矩必須大於軟鋼的降伏彎矩，否則殘留變位無法消除。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「旗形遲滯迴圈」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A jointed precast frame clamps beams to columns with unbonded post-tensioning tendons; in an earthquake a gap opens between beam end and column face while the members themselves stay nearly undamaged, and after shaking the prestress closes the gap and returns the structure to its original position, which is self-centring. Prestress alone gives hysteresis loops with almost no area and too little dissipation, so yielding mild-steel bars or dissipating devices are added to produce a flag-shaped loop that both dissipates energy and returns to zero on unloading. The key is that the restoring moment from prestress must exceed the yield moment of the mild steel, otherwise residual drift cannot be removed. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Flag-shaped hysteresis” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：預力 P = 1,200 kN、對壓力中心力臂 0.35 m，M_pt = 420 kN·m；軟鋼 A_s = 1,000 mm²、以 1.25 f_y = 525 MPa 計，T_s = 525 kN、力臂 0.55 m，M_s ≈ 289 kN·m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With prestress P = 1,200 kN at a 0.35 m lever arm to the compression centroid, M_pt = 420 kN·m; mild steel A_s = 1,000 mm² at 1.25 f_y = 525 MPa gives T_s = 525 kN at a 0.55 m lever arm, M_s ≈ 289 kN·m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「接頭的耗能鋼筋越多越好，因為吸收的能量越多。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "More dissipating steel in the joint is always better because it absorbs more energy." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「旗形遲滯迴圈」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Flag-shaped hysteresis”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 接合式系統的自復位與旗形遲滯
knowledge.titleEn: Self-centring and flag-shaped hysteresis in jointed systems

steps.title: 接合式系統的自復位與旗形遲滯：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Self-centring and flag-shaped hysteresis in jointed systems: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「旗形遲滯迴圈」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Flag-shaped hysteresis” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：預力 P = 1,200 kN、對壓力中心力臂 0.35 m，M_pt = 420 kN·m；軟鋼 A_s = 1,000 mm²、以 1.25 f_y = 525 MPa 計，T_s = 525 kN、力臂 0.55 m，M_s ≈ 289 kN·m。比值 λ = M_pt/M_s ≈ 1.45 > 1，卸載後預力足以把軟鋼拉回，殘留變位小。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With prestress P = 1,200 kN at a 0.35 m lever arm to the compression centroid, M_pt = 420 kN·m; mild steel A_s = 1,000 mm² at 1.25 f_y = 525 MPa gives T_s = 525 kN at a 0.55 m lever arm, M_s ≈ 289 kN·m. The ratio λ = M_pt/M_s ≈ 1.45 > 1, so on unloading the prestress can pull the mild steel back and residual drift stays small. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以接頭的彎矩—轉角分析或試驗確認旗形迴圈的形狀、卸載後殘留轉角與每循環耗能；設計報告中列出每個接頭的 M_pt、M_s 與 λ，確認在材料強度上下限下都大於 1。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Confirm the flag shape, residual rotation after unloading and energy per cycle by moment–rotation analysis or testing of the joint; list M_pt, M_s and λ for every joint in the design report and confirm λ exceeds 1 for both upper- and lower-bound material strengths.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 預力 P = 1,200 kN、對壓力中心力臂 0.35 m，M_pt = 420 kN·m；軟鋼 A_s = 1,000 mm²、以 1.25 f_y = 525 MPa 計，T_s = 525 kN、力臂 0.55 m，M_s ≈ 289 kN·m。比值 λ = M_pt/M_s ≈ 1.45 > 1，卸載後預力足以把軟鋼拉回，殘留變位小。數值為教學假設。

The ratio λ = M_pt/M_s ≈ 1.45 > 1, so on unloading the prestress can pull the mild steel back and residual drift stays small. Values are teaching assumptions.

steps.title: 接合式系統的自復位與旗形遲滯：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Self-centring and flag-shaped hysteresis in jointed systems: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「旗形遲滯迴圈」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Flag-shaped hysteresis” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以接頭的彎矩—轉角分析或試驗確認旗形迴圈的形狀、卸載後殘留轉角與每循環耗能；設計報告中列出每個接頭的 M_pt、M_s 與 λ，確認在材料強度上下限下都大於 1。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm the flag shape, residual rotation after unloading and energy per cycle by moment–rotation analysis or testing of the joint; list M_pt, M_s and λ for every joint in the design report and confirm λ exceeds 1 for both upper- and lower-bound material strengths. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計者應同時設定耗能與復位兩個目標，並在圖說中標明預力值、軟鋼面積與允許偏差；任何現場變更預力束數或鋼筋量，都須重新計算 λ 並經核可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Designers should set both dissipation and recentring targets and show prestress, mild-steel area and tolerances on drawings; any site change in strand count or bar area requires recalculating λ and approval.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若為增加耗能而放入過多軟鋼，λ 小於 1，震後縫無法閉合，結構留下明顯殘留傾斜，修復困難；預力損失過大也會降低 λ，使原本自復位的系統逐年失去復位能力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Adding too much mild steel for dissipation drops λ below 1, so gaps cannot close after the earthquake and the structure is left with visible residual lean that is hard to repair; excessive prestress loss also lowers λ, so a self-centring system gradually loses its recentring ability over the years. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以接頭的彎矩—轉角分析或試驗確認旗形迴圈的形狀、卸載後殘留轉角與每循環耗能；設計報告中列出每個接頭的 M_pt、M_s 與 λ，確認在材料強度上下限下都大於 1。

steps.title: 混合預力梁柱接頭的開口與脫黏長度：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Gap opening and debonded length in hybrid post-tensioned joints: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「混合接頭脫黏軟鋼」如何影響預鑄混凝土耐震接頭的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Debonded mild steel in hybrid joint” governs force, deformation or durability in “Seismic connections for precast concrete”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 混合接頭（hybrid connection）由穿過柱的無黏結預力鋼腱與梁上下緣灌漿套管內的軟鋼筋組成。層間變位幾乎全部轉為梁端開口轉角，開口在鋼腱處造成伸長，因鋼腱無黏結，伸長分攤到整段長度，應力增加有限、保持彈性；軟鋼筋則在接頭附近刻意脫黏一段長度，讓伸長分散在這段長度內，控制應變以避免低週疲勞斷裂。The Paramount 等預鑄混合構架建築即採用此類接頭概念。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「混合接頭脫黏軟鋼」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A hybrid connection combines unbonded post-tensioning tendons through the column with mild-steel bars grouted in ducts at the top and bottom of the beam. Almost all storey drift becomes gap-opening rotation at the beam end, which elongates the tendon; being unbonded, the tendon spreads the elongation over its full length, so stress rises modestly and stays elastic, while the mild bars are deliberately debonded over a short length near the joint so their elongation is spread over that length, limiting strain and avoiding low-cycle fatigue fracture. Precast hybrid-frame buildings such as The Paramount use this connection concept. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Debonded mild steel in hybrid joint” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：梁深 700 mm、層間變位 2%：梁端最外緣開口 0.02×700 = 14 mm，位於梁中央的鋼腱伸長 0.02×350 = 7 mm；跨越兩個接頭、長 16 m 的鋼腱應變增加 14/16,000 = 0.0875%，應力增 195,000×0.000875 ≈ 171 MPa，由 0.55 f_pu ≈ 1,023 MPa 增為約 1,194 MPa，仍低於降伏。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a 700 mm beam at 2% drift, the extreme gap is 0.02×700 = 14 mm and a mid-depth tendon elongates 0.02×350 = 7 mm per joint; over a 16 m tendon crossing two joints the strain rises by 14/16,000 = 0.0875%, adding 195,000×0.000875 ≈ 171 MPa, from 0.55 f_pu ≈ 1,023 MPa to about 1,194 MPa, still below yield.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混合接頭的鋼腱也應該灌漿黏結，這樣才更安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Tendons in a hybrid joint should also be grouted and bonded, because that is safer." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「混合接頭脫黏軟鋼」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a 700 mm beam at 2% drift, the extreme gap is 0.02×700 = 14 mm and a mid-depth tendon elongates 0.02×350 = 7 mm per joint; over a 16 m tendon crossing two joints the strain rises by 14/16,000 = 0.0875%, adding 195,000×0.000875 ≈ 171 MPa, from 0.55 f_pu ≈ 1,023 MPa to about 1,194 MPa, still below yield. steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.instruction: 等同現澆的預鑄柱常以灌漿套筒把柱主筋與基礎或下層柱的鋼筋續接：下方鋼筋插入預埋在柱底的鋼套筒，再以高強無收縮灌漿填滿，鋼筋力經灌漿黏結與套筒內的凸肋傳遞。柱底正是塑性鉸區，續接器必須能發展鋼筋的抗拉強度而不先破壞，才能讓塑性變形留在鋼筋上。接頭的弱點在施工：插筋錯位、套筒灌漿不滿或灌漿強度不足，外觀完全看不出來。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「灌漿套筒續接器」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Emulative precast columns often splice their main bars to foundation or lower-column bars with grouted sleeves: the lower bars enter steel sleeves cast into the column base, which are then filled with high-strength non-shrink grout, and bar force transfers through grout bond and ribs inside the sleeve. stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Erection sequence and temporary stability before connections are complete" and "Seating length, sliding joints and drift compatibility": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 吊裝順序與接頭完成前的臨時穩定：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Erection sequence and temporary stability before connections are complete: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「吊裝臨時斜撐」如何影響預鑄混凝土耐震接頭的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Erection temporary bracing” governs force, deformation or durability in “Seismic connections for precast concrete”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 預鑄構件在接頭灌漿、焊接或預力完成之前，只是彼此擱置的獨立構件，抗側力與穩定都依賴臨時斜撐、墊塊與臨時螺栓。施工階段的風、吊車碰撞或小地震，都可能在此時造成連續傾倒。因此吊裝計畫必須定義每一階段的穩定系統：哪些構件先完成永久接頭、臨時斜撐何時可以拆除、上方可以吊裝多少層而不超過下方未灌漿接頭的能力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「吊裝臨時斜撐」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Before connections are grouted, welded or post-tensioned, precast members are independent pieces resting on each other, relying on temporary braces, shims and erection bolts for lateral resistance and stability. Wind, crane impact or a small earthquake during this phase can trigger progressive toppling. The erection plan must therefore define the stability system at every stage: which members receive permanent connections first, when temporary braces may be removed, and how many levels may be erected above ungrouted joints without exceeding their capacity. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Erection temporary bracing” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：預鑄牆板寬 3.0 m、高 4.0 m，施工期風壓 0.8 kPa：風力 F = 0.8×3.0×4.0 = 9.6 kN，作用於 2.0 m 高，傾覆彎矩 19.2 kN·m；斜撐接於 3.0 m 高處，水平分力 19.2/3.0 = 6.4 kN，斜撐與地面 60°，軸力 6.4/cos60° = 12.8 kN，兩支各 6.4 kN，乘 1.6 後各約 10.2 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A precast wall panel 3.0 m wide and 4.0 m high under a construction-stage wind pressure of 0.8 kPa receives F = 0.8×3.0×4.0 = 9.6 kN at 2.0 m height, an overturning moment of 19.2 kN·m; braces attached at 3.0 m height need a horizontal component of 19.2/3.0 = 6.4 kN, and at 60° to the ground the axial force is 6.4/cos60° = 12.8 kN, 6.4 kN in each of two braces, or about 10.2 kN each with a 1.6 factor.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「預鑄構件很重，放上去之後自己就很穩，不需要臨時斜撐。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Precast members are heavy, so once set they are stable without temporary bracing." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「吊裝臨時斜撐」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Erection temporary bracing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 吊裝順序與接頭完成前的臨時穩定：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Erection sequence and temporary stability before connections are complete: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「吊裝臨時斜撐」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Erection temporary bracing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：預鑄牆板寬 3.0 m、高 4.0 m，施工期風壓 0.8 kPa：風力 F = 0.8×3.0×4.0 = 9.6 kN，作用於 2.0 m 高，傾覆彎矩 19.2 kN·m；斜撐接於 3.0 m 高處，水平分力 19.2/3.0 = 6.4 kN，斜撐與地面 60°，軸力 6.4/cos60° = 12.8 kN，兩支各 6.4 kN，乘 1.6 後各約 10.2 kN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A precast wall panel 3.0 m wide and 4.0 m high under a construction-stage wind pressure of 0.8 kPa receives F = 0.8×3.0×4.0 = 9.6 kN at 2.0 m height, an overturning moment of 19.2 kN·m; braces attached at 3.0 m height need a horizontal component of 19.2/3.0 = 6.4 kN, and at 60° to the ground the axial force is 6.4/cos60° = 12.8 kN, 6.4 kN in each of two braces, or about 10.2 kN each with a 1.6 factor. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：吊裝計畫附臨時穩定計算、斜撐與地錨的容量、拆除條件與停止風速；每日開工前檢查斜撐、墊塊與臨時螺栓，接頭灌漿強度達到規定值（以試體證明）後才拆除臨時斜撐，並記錄日期與拆除人員。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The erection plan includes temporary stability calculations, capacities of braces and ground anchors, removal conditions and stop-work wind speeds; braces, shims and erection bolts are inspected before work each day, and braces are removed only after joint grout reaches the specified strength, proven by cubes, with dates and personnel recorded.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.title: 支承長度、滑動縫與層間變位相容：機制與傳力路徑

steps.instruction: 預鑄樓梯與樓板擱置在梁或牛腿上，地震時上下樓層產生相對位移，若樓梯兩端都被固定，它會像斜撐一樣受壓而破壞；若一端設計為滑動，滑動量與支承長度必須足以容納最大層間變位，並保留施工誤差與邊緣剝落的餘裕。2011 年基督城地震中，Forsyth Barr 大樓與 Grand Chancellor 飯店的預鑄樓梯崩落，就是滑動縫與支承長度不足以容納層間變位的教訓，紐西蘭皇家調查委員會報告對建築非主結構構件的變位相容提出檢討。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「樓梯滑動支承長度」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Precast stairs and floor units sit on beams or corbels; in an earthquake the floors above and below move relative to each other, and a stair fixed at both ends acts like a brace and fails in compression. In the 2011 Christchurch earthquake, precast stairs collapsed in the Forsyth Barr building and the Hotel Grand Chancellor, a lesson in sliding joints and seats too small for storey drift, and the Canterbury Earthquakes Royal Commission reviewed the deformation compatibility of elements outside the primary structure. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Stair sliding-seat length” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：樓高 3.5 m、最大層間變位 2.5%，相對位移 0.025×3,500 = 87.5 mm。滑動端支承長度 ≥ 87.5 + 施工誤差 20 + 邊緣剝落 20 + 最小承壓 50 ≈ 178 mm，另一側間隙也須 ≥ 87.5 mm，否則樓梯受壓頂住。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a 3.5 m storey and 2.5% maximum drift, the relative displacement is 0.025×3,500 = 87.5 mm. The sliding-end seat must be at least 87.5 + 20 construction tolerance + 20 edge spalling + 50 minimum bearing ≈ 178 mm, and the gap on the other side at least 87.5 mm, or the stair jams in compression. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以結構分析取得每層最大層間變位（含扭轉），換算各樓梯與樓板的滑動需求；安裝後實測每支樓梯的支承長度與兩側間隙並拍照，確認間隙未被砂漿、裝修材或防火填縫硬性材料填滿。

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.title: 支承長度、滑動縫與層間變位相容：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Seating length, sliding joints and drift compatibility: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「樓梯滑動支承長度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Stair sliding-seat length” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以結構分析取得每層最大層間變位（含扭轉），換算各樓梯與樓板的滑動需求；安裝後實測每支樓梯的支承長度與兩側間隙並拍照，確認間隙未被砂漿、裝修材或防火填縫硬性材料填滿。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Obtain each storey's maximum drift, including torsion, from analysis and convert it into sliding demand for every stair and floor unit; after installation measure and photograph each stair's seating length and gaps on both sides, confirming they are not filled with mortar, finishes or rigid firestopping. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：圖說應標示每支樓梯的固定端與滑動端、最小支承長度與間隙，並規定間隙只能以可壓縮材料填充；裝修與防火填縫施工前須確認不影響滑動。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Drawings should show the fixed and sliding end of every stair, minimum seating length and gap, and require gaps to be filled only with compressible material; fit-out and firestopping must be checked not to impede sliding.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：間隙被水泥砂漿或裝修材料填死時，樓梯變成斜撐，地震中受壓破壞或把支承推落；支承長度只按重力設計，大變位時樓梯從牛腿滑落，阻斷逃生通道。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Gaps packed with mortar or finishes turn the stair into a brace that fails in compression or pushes off its seat; seats sized only for gravity let stairs slide off corbels at large drift, cutting off the escape route. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 支承長度、滑動縫與層間變位相容：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Seating length, sliding joints and drift compatibility: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「樓梯滑動支承長度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 間隙被水泥砂漿或裝修材料填死時，樓梯變成斜撐，地震中受壓破壞或把支承推落；支承長度只按重力設計，大變位時樓梯從牛腿滑落，阻斷逃生通道。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：2011 年基督城地震中，Forsyth Barr 大樓與 Grand Chancellor 飯店的預鑄樓梯崩落，就是滑動縫與支承長度不足以容納層間變位的教訓，紐西蘭皇家調查委員會報告對建築非主結構構件的變位相容提出檢討。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Fixing both ends of a precast stair is sturdier and safer in an earthquake." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: ACI 374.1 試驗允收與能量消散比：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: ACI 374.1 test acceptance and energy-dissipation ratio: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「反覆載重試驗允收」如何影響預鑄混凝土耐震接頭的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cyclic test acceptance” governs force, deformation or durability in “Seismic connections for precast concrete”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 接合式預鑄構架的行為不能完全以現澆規範推論，因此 ACI 374.1 以結構試驗作為允收依據：以實尺度或大尺度梁柱子結構承受逐級增大的反覆位移，至少到 3.5% 層間變位，並檢查強度保持、相對能量消散比與卸載後的勁度。ACI 550.3 則針對以無黏結預力形成的預鑄特殊抗彎構架，規定在符合這些試驗允收的前提下的設計方法。試驗的價值是同時證明強度、韌性與耗能，而不是只看最大承載力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「反覆載重試驗允收」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The behaviour of jointed precast frames cannot be inferred entirely from cast-in-place rules, so ACI 374.1 makes structural testing the basis for acceptance: full- or large-scale beam–column subassemblies are cycled at increasing displacements up to at least 3.5% drift, and strength retention, relative energy-dissipation ratio and stiffness around zero are checked. ACI 550.3 then gives design methods for precast special moment frames with unbonded post-tensioning that satisfy these acceptance criteria. The value of testing is that it proves strength, ductility and dissipation together rather than peak capacity alone. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Cyclic test acceptance” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：相對能量消散比 β = A_loop/A_par。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Relative energy-dissipation ratio β = A_loop/A_par.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要試體的最大承載力達到設計值，接頭就算通過試驗。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A joint passes testing as soon as the specimen reaches its design peak strength." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.

quiz.explanation: 接合式預鑄構架的行為不能完全以現澆規範推論，因此 ACI 374.1 以結構試驗作為允收依據：以實尺度或大尺度梁柱子結構承受逐級增大的反覆位移，至少到 3.5% 層間變位，並檢查強度保持、相對能量消散比與卸載後的勁度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The behaviour of jointed precast frames cannot be inferred entirely from cast-in-place rules, so ACI 374.1 makes structural testing the basis for acceptance: full- or large-scale beam–column subassemblies are cycled at increasing displacements up to at least 3.5% drift, and strength retention, relative energy-dissipation ratio and stiffness around zero are checked. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: ACI 374.1 試驗允收與能量消散比：定量估算
steps.titleEn: ACI 374.1 test acceptance and energy-dissipation ratio: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「反覆載重試驗允收」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cyclic test acceptance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：相對能量消散比 β = A_loop/A_par。在 3.5% 變位的第三循環，迴圈面積 26 kJ；以 ±400 kN 尖峰力與扣除彈性段後各 0.09 m 的位移形成的平行四邊形面積 (400+400)×(0.09+0.09) = 144 kJ，β = 26/144 ≈ 0.18，高於 1/8 = 0.125 的允收下限。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Relative energy-dissipation ratio β = A_loop/A_par. In the third cycle at 3.5% drift the loop area is 26 kJ; the parallelogram formed by ±400 kN peaks and 0.09 m of post-elastic displacement each way has area (400+400)×(0.09+0.09) = 144 kJ, so β = 26/144 ≈ 0.18, above the acceptance minimum of 1/8 = 0.125. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：審查試驗報告時確認試體尺寸與細部代表實際接頭、加載程序達到 3.5% 且每級有足夠循環，第三循環尖峰力不低於最大力的規定比例、β 不低於 1/8，並檢查卸載後殘留變位與損傷照片。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: When reviewing a test report, confirm that specimen size and detailing represent the real joint, that the protocol reaches 3.5% with enough cycles at each level, that third-cycle peak force stays above the required fraction of the maximum and β is at least 1/8, and examine residual drift after unloading and damage photographs.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: ACI 374.1 試驗允收與能量消散比：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「反覆載重試驗允收」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cyclic test acceptance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 審查試驗報告時確認試體尺寸與細部代表實際接頭、加載程序達到 3.5% 且每級有足夠循環，第三循環尖峰力不低於最大力的規定比例、β 不低於 1/8，並檢查卸載後殘留變位與損傷照片。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: When reviewing a test report, confirm that specimen size and detailing represent the real joint, that the protocol reaches 3.5% with enough cycles at each level, that third-cycle peak force stays above the required fraction of the maximum and β is at least 1/8, and examine residual drift after unloading and damage photographs. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：採用新型預鑄接頭前，須確認已有符合 ACI 374.1 的試驗或安排專案試驗，試驗計畫與報告由設計者與審查者核可；試驗涵蓋範圍外的尺寸變更不得逕行套用。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Before adopting a new precast joint, confirm that ACI 374.1-compliant tests exist or arrange project tests, with test plan and report approved by designer and reviewer; size changes beyond the tested range must not be applied without justification.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若以試體縮尺過小或細部簡化的試驗結果套用到實際接頭，混凝土保護層剝落、灌漿與錨碇行為都不相同，實際接頭可能在較小變位就失去強度；只看最大力而忽略第三循環的強度衰減，會高估韌性。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.title: ACI 374.1 試驗允收與能量消散比：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: ACI 374.1 test acceptance and energy-dissipation ratio: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「反覆載重試驗允收」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cyclic test acceptance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若以試體縮尺過小或細部簡化的試驗結果套用到實際接頭，混凝土保護層剝落、灌漿與錨碇行為都不相同，實際接頭可能在較小變位就失去強度；只看最大力而忽略第三循環的強度衰減，會高估韌性。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Applying results from a specimen that is too small or simplified to real joints ignores differences in cover spalling, grouting and anchorage, so real joints may lose strength at smaller drifts; looking only at peak force and ignoring third-cycle strength decay overstates ductility. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：試驗的價值是同時證明強度、韌性與耗能，而不是只看最大承載力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The value of testing is that it proves strength, ductility and dissipation together rather than peak capacity alone.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要試體的最大承載力達到設計值，接頭就算通過試驗。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A joint passes testing as soon as the specimen reaches its design peak strength." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 大型系統試驗與縮尺相似律：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Large system tests and scaling similitude: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「PRESSS 五層試驗建築」如何影響預鑄混凝土耐震接頭的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “PRESSS five-storey test building” governs force, deformation or durability in “Seismic connections for precast concrete”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 接頭試驗證明單一接頭，系統試驗則檢查整棟建築中樓板、接頭、牆與構架是否協同運作。1999 年在加州大學聖地牙哥分校完成的 PRESSS 五層預鑄試驗建築，以約 60% 縮尺在同一棟試驗建築的兩個方向分別放入多種預鑄構架與接合式剪力牆系統，以擬動態方式施加逐級增大的地震，驗證了混合構架與接合式牆的自復位與低損傷表現，後續影響了 ACI 規範與 The Paramount 等建築。縮尺試驗必須了解相似律，才能把試驗力量換回實尺度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「PRESSS 五層試驗建築」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Joint tests prove single connections; system tests check that floors, joints, walls and frames work together in a whole building. Scaled tests require an understanding of similitude to convert test forces back to full scale. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “PRESSS five-storey test building” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以相同材料做縮尺 λ = 0.6 的試驗：應力相同，力量比 λ² = 0.36、彎矩比 λ³ ≈ 0.216。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a test at scale λ = 0.6 with the same materials, stresses are equal, forces scale by λ² = 0.36 and moments by λ³ ≈ 0.216.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「縮尺試驗的力量直接乘上縮尺比就能換回實尺度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.check: 傳力圖標明「PRESSS 五層試驗建築」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

The PRESSS five-storey precast test building, completed at the University of California, San Diego in 1999 at about 60% scale, placed several precast frame types in one direction and a jointed shear-wall system in the other, applied earthquakes of increasing intensity pseudodynamically, and demonstrated the self-centring, low-damage behaviour of hybrid frames and jointed walls, later influencing ACI provisions and buildings such as The Paramount.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：縮尺試驗的力量直接乘上縮尺比就能換回實尺度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Scaled-test forces convert to full scale by multiplying by the scale factor alone. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「大型系統試驗與縮尺相似律」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Large system tests and scaling similitude" is correct?
options: 縮尺試驗的力量直接乘上縮尺比就能換回實尺度。
接頭被混凝土包住後就安全了，不需要再檢測。
接頭試驗證明單一接頭，系統試驗則檢查整棟建築中樓板、接頭、牆與構架是否協同運作。
optionsEn: Scaled-test forces convert to full scale by multiplying by the scale factor alone.
Once a connection is encased in concrete it is safe and needs no further testing.
Joint tests prove single connections; system tests check that floors, joints, walls and frames work together in a whole building.
quiz.explanation: 接頭試驗證明單一接頭，系統試驗則檢查整棟建築中樓板、接頭、牆與構架是否協同運作。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Joint tests prove single connections; system tests check that floors, joints, walls and frames work together in a whole building. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 大型系統試驗與縮尺相似律：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Large system tests and scaling similitude: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「PRESSS 五層試驗建築」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “PRESSS five-storey test building” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以相同材料做縮尺 λ = 0.6 的試驗：應力相同，力量比 λ² = 0.36、彎矩比 λ³ ≈ 0.216。實尺度梁端彎矩 420 kN·m 在試體中只有約 0.216×420 ≈ 91 kN·m，實尺度預力 1,200 kN 對應約 0.36×1,200 ≈ 432 kN；層間變位比則與實尺度相同。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a test at scale λ = 0.6 with the same materials, stresses are equal, forces scale by λ² = 0.36 and moments by λ³ ≈ 0.216. A full-scale beam-end moment of 420 kN·m becomes about 0.216×420 ≈ 91 kN·m in the specimen and a full-scale prestress of 1,200 kN about 0.36×1,200 ≈ 432 kN, while drift ratios are the same as at full scale. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：檢查系統試驗的縮尺比、材料與鋼筋尺寸是否一致縮放，擬動態試驗的質量與地震紀錄時間軸如何處理，並把試驗的變位、殘留變位與損傷照片換算回實尺度，與設計假設比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check the scale of a system test, whether materials and bar sizes were scaled consistently, how mass and the earthquake time axis were handled in pseudodynamic testing, and convert drifts, residual drifts and damage photographs back to full scale for comparison with design assumptions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 以相同材料做縮尺 λ = 0.6 的試驗：應力相同，力量比 λ² = 0.36、彎矩比 λ³ ≈ 0.216。實尺度梁端彎矩 420 kN·m 在試體中只有約 0.216×420 ≈ 91 kN·m，實尺度預力 1,200 kN 對應約 0.36×1,200 ≈ 432 kN；層間變位比則與實尺度相同。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a test at scale λ = 0.6 with the same materials, stresses are equal, forces scale by λ² = 0.36 and moments by λ³ ≈ 0.216. A full-scale beam-end moment of 420 kN·m becomes about 0.216×420 ≈ 91 kN·m in the specimen and a full-scale prestress of 1,200 kN about 0.36×1,200 ≈ 432 kN, while drift ratios are the same as at full scale. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「大型系統試驗與縮尺相似律」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Large system tests and scaling similitude", which statement holds?
options: 以相同材料做縮尺 λ = 0.6 的試驗：應力相同，力量比 λ² = 0.36、彎矩比 λ³ ≈ 0.216。
預鑄構件本身強度足夠，接頭只要能承受重力就好。
混合接頭的鋼腱也應該灌漿黏結，這樣才更安全。

If precast members are strong enough, connections only need to carry gravity loads.
Tendons in a hybrid joint should also be grouted and bonded, because that is safer.
quiz.explanation: 以相同材料做縮尺 λ = 0.6 的試驗：應力相同，力量比 λ² = 0.36、彎矩比 λ³ ≈ 0.216。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a test at scale λ = 0.6 with the same materials, stresses are equal, forces scale by λ² = 0.36 and moments by λ³ ≈ 0.216. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 大型系統試驗與縮尺相似律：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Large system tests and scaling similitude: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「PRESSS 五層試驗建築」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “PRESSS five-storey test building” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 檢查系統試驗的縮尺比、材料與鋼筋尺寸是否一致縮放，擬動態試驗的質量與地震紀錄時間軸如何處理，並把試驗的變位、殘留變位與損傷照片換算回實尺度，與設計假設比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check the scale of a system test, whether materials and bar sizes were scaled consistently, how mass and the earthquake time axis were handled in pseudodynamic testing, and convert drifts, residual drifts and damage photographs back to full scale for comparison with design assumptions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：引用系統試驗作為設計依據時，在計算書中說明縮尺、相似律換算與適用範圍；實際工程的樓板與梁接合方式應與試驗一致，否則須評估開口行為對樓板的影響。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When citing a system test as design basis, explain the scale, similitude conversion and range of applicability in the calculations; the project's floor-to-beam connection should match the test, or the effect of gap opening on the floor must be assessed.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若縮尺試驗的鋼筋直徑、粗骨材或灌漿厚度沒有按比例縮小，黏結與錨碇行為與實尺度不同，試驗可能高估或低估接頭韌性；忽略樓板對梁的束制，則系統試驗中觀察到的開口行為不會出現在設計分析中。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If bar diameters, coarse aggregate or grout thickness are not scaled in proportion, bond and anchorage differ from full scale and the test may over- or underestimate joint ductility; ignoring floor restraint on beams means the gap behaviour seen in system tests is missing from design analysis. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 檢查系統試驗的縮尺比、材料與鋼筋尺寸是否一致縮放，擬動態試驗的質量與地震紀錄時間軸如何處理，並把試驗的變位、殘留變位與損傷照片換算回實尺度，與設計假設比較。
knowledge.textEn: Check the scale of a system test, whether materials and bar sizes were scaled consistently, how mass and the earthquake time axis were handled in pseudodynamic testing, and convert drifts, residual drifts and damage photographs back to full scale for comparison with design assumptions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 引用系統試驗作為設計依據時，在計算書中說明縮尺、相似律換算與適用範圍；實際工程的樓板與梁接合方式應與試驗一致，否則須評估開口行為對樓板的影響。
knowledge.textEn: When citing a system test as design basis, explain the scale, similitude conversion and range of applicability in the calculations; the project's floor-to-beam connection should match the test, or the effect of gap opening on the floor must be assessed.

quiz.question: 要驗證「大型系統試驗與縮尺相似律」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Large system tests and scaling similitude"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
檢查系統試驗的縮尺比、材料與鋼筋尺寸是否一致縮放，擬動態試驗的質量與地震紀錄時間軸如何處理，並把試驗的變位、殘留變位與損傷照片換算回實尺度，與設計假設比較。
預鑄構件很重，放上去之後自己就很穩，不需要臨時斜撐。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.

Check the scale of a system test, whether materials and bar sizes were scaled consistently, how mass and the earthquake time axis were handled in pseudodynamic testing, and convert drifts, residual drifts and damage photographs back to full scale for comparison with design assumptions.
Precast members are heavy, so once set they are stable without temporary bracing.
quiz.explanation: 檢查系統試驗的縮尺比、材料與鋼筋尺寸是否一致縮放，擬動態試驗的質量與地震紀錄時間軸如何處理，並把試驗的變位、殘留變位與損傷照片換算回實尺度，與設計假設比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check the scale of a system test, whether materials and bar sizes were scaled consistently, how mass and the earthquake time axis were handled in pseudodynamic testing, and convert drifts, residual drifts and damage photographs back to full scale for comparison with design assumptions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 大型系統試驗與縮尺相似律：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Large system tests and scaling similitude: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「PRESSS 五層試驗建築」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “PRESSS five-storey test building” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若縮尺試驗的鋼筋直徑、粗骨材或灌漿厚度沒有按比例縮小，黏結與錨碇行為與實尺度不同，試驗可能高估或低估接頭韌性；忽略樓板對梁的束制，則系統試驗中觀察到的開口行為不會出現在設計分析中。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If bar diameters, coarse aggregate or grout thickness are not scaled in proportion, bond and anchorage differ from full scale and the test may over- or underestimate joint ductility; ignoring floor restraint on beams means the gap behaviour seen in system tests is missing from design analysis. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：縮尺試驗必須了解相似律，才能把試驗力量換回實尺度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Scaled tests require an understanding of similitude to convert test forces back to full scale.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「縮尺試驗的力量直接乘上縮尺比就能換回實尺度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Scaled-test forces convert to full scale by multiplying by the scale factor alone." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若縮尺試驗的鋼筋直徑、粗骨材或灌漿厚度沒有按比例縮小，黏結與錨碇行為與實尺度不同，試驗可能高估或低估接頭韌性；忽略樓板對梁的束制，則系統試驗中觀察到的開口行為不會出現在設計分析中。
knowledge.textEn: If bar diameters, coarse aggregate or grout thickness are not scaled in proportion, bond and anchorage differ from full scale and the test may over- or underestimate joint ductility; ignoring floor restraint on beams means the gap behaviour seen in system tests is missing from design analysis.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「大型系統試驗與縮尺相似律」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Large system tests and scaling similitude" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
接頭被混凝土包住後就安全了，不需要再檢測。
若縮尺試驗的鋼筋直徑、粗骨材或灌漿厚度沒有按比例縮小，黏結與錨碇行為與實尺度不同，試驗可能高估或低估接頭韌性。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Once a connection is encased in concrete it is safe and needs no further testing.
If bar diameters, coarse aggregate or grout thickness are not scaled in proportion, bond and anchorage differ from full scale and the test may over- or underestimate joint ductility.
quiz.explanation: 若縮尺試驗的鋼筋直徑、粗骨材或灌漿厚度沒有按比例縮小，黏結與錨碇行為與實尺度不同，試驗可能高估或低估接頭韌性；忽略樓板對梁的束制，則系統試驗中觀察到的開口行為不會出現在設計分析中。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If bar diameters, coarse aggregate or grout thickness are not scaled in proportion, bond and anchorage differ from full scale and the test may over- or underestimate joint ductility; ignoring floor restraint on beams means the gap behaviour seen in system tests is missing from design analysis. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「隱蔽接頭的檢測與灌漿缺陷」與「震後評估、預力復驗與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Inspection of hidden connections and grouting defects" and "Post-earthquake assessment, prestress checks and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 隱蔽接頭的檢測與灌漿缺陷：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Inspection of hidden connections and grouting defects: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「套筒灌漿非破壞檢測」如何影響預鑄混凝土耐震接頭的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Non-destructive testing of sleeve grout” governs force, deformation or durability in “Seismic connections for precast concrete”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 預鑄接頭最難管理的是隱蔽在混凝土內的部分：灌漿套筒、預力套管、預埋鋼板與焊接接合器，一旦封閉就無法目視。檢測必須在施工中留下紀錄，並在完工後以非破壞方法抽查，例如超音波、X 光或衝擊回音法檢測套筒灌漿飽滿度，內視鏡檢查預力套管，鋼筋掃描確認預埋件位置。使用期間則以防水、防蝕與定期檢查維持外露接合器與預埋鋼板的狀態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「套筒灌漿非破壞檢測」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The hardest part of precast connections to manage is what lies hidden inside concrete: grouted sleeves, post-tensioning ducts, embedded plates and welded connectors cannot be seen once closed. Inspection must leave records during construction and be followed by non-destructive sampling after completion, for example ultrasonic, X-ray or impact-echo checks of sleeve grout fill, borescopes in post-tensioning ducts and cover scanning to locate embeds. In service, waterproofing, corrosion protection and periodic inspection maintain exposed connectors and embedded plates. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Non-destructive testing of sleeve grout” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：套筒每側埋入 512 mm，若灌漿只填滿 70%，有效埋入 0.7×512 ≈ 358 mm，低於發展鋼筋抗拉強度所需的 413 mm，續接器只能發展約 358/413 ≈ 87% 的鋼筋強度，柱底在塑性鉸形成前就可能拔出。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With 512 mm of embedment per side, a sleeve only 70% filled offers 0.7×512 ≈ 358 mm, below the 413 mm needed to develop the bar's tensile strength, so the splice develops only about 358/413 ≈ 87% of bar strength and the column base may pull out before a plastic hinge forms.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：套筒每側埋入 512 mm，若灌漿只填滿 70%，有效埋入 0.7×512 ≈ 358 mm，低於發展鋼筋抗拉強度所需的 413 mm，續接器只能發展約 358/413 ≈ 87% 的鋼筋強度，柱底在塑性鉸形成前就可能拔出。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With 512 mm of embedment per side, a sleeve only 70% filled offers 0.7×512 ≈ 358 mm, below the 413 mm needed to develop the bar's tensile strength, so the splice develops only about 358/413 ≈ 87% of bar strength and the column base may pull out before a plastic hinge forms. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Apply non-destructive testing to grouted sleeves according to a sampling plan, for example a set proportion per floor with expanded sampling when defects appear, confirming suspect sleeves by drilled borescope inspection or regrouting; compare results with grouting logs and record defect locations and treatment in the as-built records.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.instruction: 依抽樣計畫對灌漿套筒做非破壞檢測（例如每層一定比例，發現缺陷即擴大抽樣），可疑者以鑽孔內視或補灌確認；檢測結果與施工灌漿紀錄對照，並把缺陷位置與處置寫入竣工資料。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.instruction: 接合式預鑄建築的優點是震後損傷少、可快速復原，但必須證明預力仍在、縫已閉合、樓梯與樓板支承未移位。震後檢查要量測殘留層間變位、梁端殘留開口、軟鋼脫黏段附近的混凝土狀態，並以千斤頂浮升試驗確認鋼腱預力；等同現澆的接頭則檢查柱底與梁端塑性鉸區裂縫與剝落。交接文件需記錄每種接頭的位置、型式、預力值與檢測紀錄，讓未來的評估有依據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「預力浮升檢驗」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

knowledge.title: 震後評估、預力復驗與交接
knowledge.titleEn: Post-earthquake assessment, prestress checks and handover
knowledge.text: 接合式預鑄建築的優點是震後損傷少、可快速復原，但必須證明預力仍在、縫已閉合、樓梯與樓板支承未移位。震後檢查要量測殘留層間變位、梁端殘留開口、軟鋼脫黏段附近的混凝土狀態，並以千斤頂浮升試驗確認鋼腱預力；等同現澆的接頭則檢查柱底與梁端塑性鉸區裂縫與剝落。
knowledge.textEn: The advantage of jointed precast buildings is little damage and quick recovery after an earthquake, but engineers must prove that prestress remains, gaps have closed and stair and floor seats have not shifted. Post-earthquake inspection measures residual drift and residual gap at beam ends, examines concrete near the debonded mild-steel zones and confirms tendon force by jack lift-off tests; emulative joints are checked for cracking and spalling in column-base and beam-end hinge zones.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：浮升試驗以千斤頂活塞面積 0.030 m² 量測：設計預力 1,200 kN 對應 40 MPa 油壓；若錨碇在 34 MPa 時浮升，實際預力約 0.030×34,000 ≈ 1,020 kN，損失約 15%，λ 由 1.45 降到約 1.45×0.85 ≈ 1.23，仍大於 1，但應評估是否重新施拉。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A lift-off test uses a jack with 0.030 m² piston area: the design prestress of 1,200 kN corresponds to 40 MPa; if the anchorage lifts off at 34 MPa, the actual force is about 0.030×34,000 ≈ 1,020 kN, a loss of about 15%, so λ falls from 1.45 to about 1.45×0.85 ≈ 1.23, still above 1 but warranting assessment for restressing. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：地震後依檢查表量測各層殘留變位、梁端開口、樓梯支承位移與間隙，抽樣做預力浮升試驗並與完工基準比較；預力損失或殘留變位超過允許值時，由結構技師評估重新施拉、更換軟鋼或其他修復。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After an earthquake, follow a checklist to measure residual drift, beam-end gaps, stair seat movement and gaps on each floor, and lift-off-test sample tendons against completion baselines; where prestress loss or residual drift exceeds limits, the structural engineer assesses restressing, mild-steel replacement or other repairs.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 震後評估、預力復驗與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Post-earthquake assessment, prestress checks and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「預力浮升檢驗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Prestress lift-off check” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 地震後依檢查表量測各層殘留變位、梁端開口、樓梯支承位移與間隙，抽樣做預力浮升試驗並與完工基準比較；預力損失或殘留變位超過允許值時，由結構技師評估重新施拉、更換軟鋼或其他修復。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After an earthquake, follow a checklist to measure residual drift, beam-end gaps, stair seat movement and gaps on each floor, and lift-off-test sample tendons against completion baselines; where prestress loss or residual drift exceeds limits, the structural engineer assesses restressing, mild-steel replacement or other repairs. steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover should include connection type and location plans, stressing and lift-off baselines, grouting and NDT records, stair sliding-end and gap records and the post-earthquake checklist, and require removable anchorage caps for inspection; any alteration affecting connections or stair gaps needs prior structural engineer approval.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若完工時沒有記錄預力基準與錨碇可檢查的設計，震後無法確認預力是否損失，只能保守地長期停用；樓梯支承在地震中移位卻未被檢查，下一次地震或日常使用中才突然崩落。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
